item.title: Bulletin updated at 12:00 HKT 12/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of replenishments of the northeast monsoon and a rainband, it will be rather cool over the coastal areas of Guangdong in the next few days. An intense winter monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China during the weekend. Winds will strengthen from the north and it will become cold appreciably over the region. The weather will improve. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Pakhar will move across the seas south of the Ryukyu Islands today and tomorrow and weaken gradually.

Date/Month: 13/12 (Tuesday)
Wind: North force 4, force 5 at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches later. Rather cool in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 14 - 18 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
